title: [P2] Define how the completed external seal resolves administrative pending
requirement: Human requires recoverable/executable/acceptable new workflow; AGENTS mandatory actual-state recovery and canonical §13 require correct handoff/next action. Independent-review.md requires recovery/evidence consistency.
trigger: After the final administrative SHA actually passes both fresh reviews, hosted checks, protected merge, actual-main CI and second safe synchronization and the Coordinator publishes the final external seal, then a fresh Agent resumes from this immutable committed current/task/checkpoint.
body: The entry point permanently labels execution administrative_closure_pending and directs NEW reviews/CI/sync, while the only final-seal text says it is PENDING and not asserted to exist/pass. None of current, current Task Handoff/Next Action, accepted-product acceptance, or the new checkpoint tells a resumed Agent to inspect an existing seal first, verify its candidate/main and evidence bindings, or treat exactly the completed administrative pending statements as historical after success. A completed real closure therefore has no documented consumption path: a resumed Agent must either repeat a completed administrative cycle/change accepted source again, or infer an acceptance override without defined validation. This is a recovery behavior gap, not a request to predeclare future PASS.
smallest_fix: Add one subordinate prose resolver, linked by current/Task/checkpoint. Read the named final seal first when it exists; validate task/product/admin candidate/main identities, source receipt and artifact hashes, two different fresh same-final-SHA review results/independence, actual required exact-head candidate and actual-main CI jobs/steps, protected merge/tree binding, and second safe synchronization/preserved unknown/index evidence. Only complete valid evidence resolves these candidate-time administrative pending statements, without recursively editing accepted source or authorizing another task/S2 Gate. Missing, malformed, mismatched or incomplete evidence keeps pending and resumes the exact missing step. Existence or a PASS word alone must not count. No product/authority change or generic new resolver framework is needed.
validation: Fresh reviewer can recover three states from repository prose: seal absent, seal present but invalid/incomplete, seal fully valid. Only the third resolves administrative closure; all retain S2 OPEN and current stop boundary. Existing static tests passing does not exercise this future evidence-consumption path.
